DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 今日は、どのような過ごし方をお考えですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: How are you thinking of spending today?

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 雨で昨日の予定がなくなりました。今日中に全部回れば取り戻せると思ったのですが、移動ばかりになりそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 雨で失った予定を今日へ詰め込むと移動ばかりになると相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Yesterday's plans were canceled by rain. I thought visiting everything today would make up for it, but it looks like I'd spend all my time traveling.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Discuss how cramming rain-canceled plans into today would mean constant travel. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 行く場所の数より、楽しみにしていたことから考えてみましょう。特に何をしたかったですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Rather than the number of places, let's start with what you were looking forward to. What especially did you want to do?

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 手仕事の道具をゆっくり見て、形をスケッチしたかったです。写真を何枚も撮るために来たわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 道具をゆっくり見てスケッチしたいという旅行目的を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: I wanted to take my time looking at craft tools and sketch their shapes. I didn't come just to take lots of photos.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Explain your travel aim of slowly viewing and sketching tools. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: でしたら、この案内にある道具の展示を一か所選ぶ方法があります。館内での筆記については、先方へ確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Then you could choose one tool exhibition from this guide. Check with the venue about writing or drawing inside.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: その展示にします。一つの道具の形や使い方を、じっくり見てみたいです。ほかの予約は入れません。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 一か所の展示を選び追加予約を入れないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'll choose that exhibition. I'd like to spend time studying one tool's shape and use. I won't make any other bookings.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Choose one exhibition and say you won't add reservations. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: お帰りの時間には、余裕を持ってください。展示を見た後の予定は決めていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Leave plenty of time for your return. Have you decided what to do after the exhibition?

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 終わったら休憩して、気づいたことをノートに書きます。まだ余裕があっても、次の場所へ急いで移動するつもりはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 展示後は休んで記録し次の場所へ急がないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'll rest afterward and write my observations in my notebook. Even if time remains, I don't intend to rush to another place.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say you'll rest and record observations after viewing rather than rush to another venue. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: それなら、ご自身の関心に合わせて過ごせそうですね。展示の案内はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: That sounds suited to your interests. Here's the exhibition information.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-02-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-02-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。雨でできなかったことを全部埋めようとせず、今日楽しめたことを持って帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-02-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 失った予定を埋めず今日の体験を大切にすると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-02-001-SHARED-1.translation: Thank you. Instead of trying to replace everything the rain prevented, I'll take home what I enjoyed today.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-02-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Say you'll value today's experience rather than fill every lost plan. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-02-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-02-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: どうぞ、心に残る時間をお過ごしください。それでは、よいご旅行を。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-02-001-SHARED-1.translation: I hope you have a memorable time. Enjoy your trip.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: ご試着のサイズはいかがでしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: How was the size you tried on?

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 大きさは合います。でも、胸の文字が逆に見えます。文字を間違えて縫った商品なのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 鏡で文字が逆に見える上着が不良か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: The size fits. But the lettering on the chest looks reversed. Was it sewn incorrectly?
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask whether a jacket whose lettering looks reversed in the mirror is defective. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 鏡に映った文字をご覧になっていますか。上着を脱いで、実物の文字を一緒に確かめましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Are you looking at the lettering in the mirror? Let's take off the jacket and check the actual letters together.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい、鏡で見ました。写真にも同じ向きで写ると思って、不安になりました。実物はまだ正面から読んでいません。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 鏡だけを見て実物を正面から確認していないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Yes, in the mirror. I worried it would appear that way in photographs too. I haven't yet read the actual garment from the front.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Explain you've only looked in the mirror and haven't checked the actual garment head-on. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: こちらの実物では、この順に文字が並んでいます。文字の部分を読んでご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: On the actual garment, the letters are arranged in this order. Please read that part to check.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 実物は読めました。鏡での見え方を、商品の間違いだと決めてしまいましたね。書いてある言葉の意味も知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 実物の文字を読み言葉の意味も尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: I can read the actual letters. I assumed the mirror image meant the product was wrong. I'd also like to know what the words mean.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Read the actual lettering and ask its meaning too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: こちらは「ゆっくり進もう」という意味の言葉です。飾りの文字として付いています。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: The words mean let's move forward slowly. They're decorative lettering.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。意味は好きです。ただ、仕事用ではなく普段着として選びたいので、文字が目立つかも考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 意味は好きだが普段着として文字の目立ち方を考えると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Thank you. I like the meaning. But I'm choosing casual wear rather than workwear, so I'll also think about how noticeable the lettering is.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say you like the meaning but will consider the lettering's prominence for casual wear. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 文字のない上着もあります。ご希望でしたら、両方を比べていただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: We also have jackets without lettering. You can compare both if you'd like.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-03-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-03-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 比べてみます。文字が正しいかは確認できたので、今度は自分が着たいかを考えて決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-03-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 文字なしの服と比べ自分が着たいかで決めると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-03-001-SHARED-1.translation: I'll compare them. Now I've confirmed the lettering is correct, I'll decide by thinking about whether I want to wear it.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-03-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Compare with unlettered clothing and decide whether you personally want to wear it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-03-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-03-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: どうぞ、ご納得のいく一着をお選びください。それでは、ほかの品もご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-03-001-SHARED-1.translation: Please choose one you're happy with. I'll show you other items too.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: こちらのパンは、お切り分けしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Would you like this bread sliced?

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 一斤買いたいです。一人暮らしなので、全部同じ厚さに切るのがよいか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 一人で食べる一斤を全部同じ厚さにするか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'd like one loaf. I live alone and am unsure whether all the slices should be the same thickness.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Discuss whether to slice an entire loaf for one person at the same thickness. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: どのように召し上がる予定ですか。厚さの数字だけでなく、食べ方も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: How do you plan to eat it? Tell me how you'll use it, not just slice-thickness numbers.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 朝は一枚を焼いて、夕方は少しだけスープと食べたいです。夕方に厚い一枚を残してしまいそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 朝は焼いた一枚で夕方はスープと少量と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: In the morning I'll toast one slice, and in the evening I want just a little with soup. I might leave part of a thick slice in the evening.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Explain you want one toasted slice in the morning and a small amount with evening soup. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 夕方の分を小さく分ける方法もあります。ご希望の大きさを、この切り分け見本でお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: We can divide the evening portion smaller. Check your preferred size with this slicing sample.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: この小さい分がよさそうです。朝の分と夕方の分を分けたいです。すぐ食べない分の保存については、何を見ればよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 見本の小さい分を選び食べない分の保存表示を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: This smaller portion looks good. I'd like morning and evening portions separated. Where should I look for storage guidance for the part I won't eat soon?
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Choose the smaller sample portion and ask about storage labels for uneaten portions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 包装の保存方法と期限の表示をご確認ください。切った後の扱いも含め、ご購入の商品について説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Check the package's storage method and date label. I'll explain this product's handling, including after cutting.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: お願いします。冷凍すれば表示を見なくてもいつまでも食べられる、とは考えないようにします。分けた日も自分でメモします。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 保存説明を聞き冷凍で無期限になると考えず分けた日を記録すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Please do. I won't think freezing means I can eat it forever without reading the label. I'll also note the day I divided it.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Hear storage guidance, avoid assuming freezing gives unlimited life, and record the division date. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: ご説明を聞いてから、切り分け方をお決めください。こちらの大きさでよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Please decide the portions after hearing the explanation. Is this size all right?

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-04-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-04-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: はい、見本の大きさでお願いします。食べる分を選びやすいように、家でも分けて包みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-04-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 見本の大きさで切り分けを頼み家でも分けて包むと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-04-001-SHARED-1.translation: Yes, the sample size, please. I'll wrap portions separately at home too so it's easy to choose what I'll eat.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-04-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Request the sample-size portions and say you'll also wrap separately at home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-04-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-04-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: ご希望の切り分けで承ります。準備できましたらお声がけします。それでは、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-04-001-SHARED-1.translation: We'll divide it as requested and call you when ready. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: この部屋の仕上げで、確認したいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Anything you'd like to check about finishing this room?

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 掃除は進めましたが、ほとんど香りがありません。自分の芳香スプレーを使えば、きれいにした感じが出るでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 香りがない部屋へ私物の芳香スプレーを使ってよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: I've been cleaning, but there's hardly any scent. Would using my own fragrance spray make it feel properly cleaned?
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask about using a personal fragrance spray in a room with little scent. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 私物のスプレーは使わずに、いったんしまってください。香りの強さだけで清掃の状態は判断しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Don't use your spray; put it away for now. We don't judge cleanliness by scent strength alone.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: まだ使っていません。前の職場では香りがあったので、同じようにしないと仕事が足りないと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 未使用で前職の香りを基準に仕事不足と思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: I haven't used it yet. My previous workplace had a scent, so I thought my work was lacking unless I did the same.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say it's unused and you judged the work insufficient by your previous workplace's scent. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: この職場で指定された作業を確認しましょう。清掃の記録と、点検してほしい箇所を見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Let's check this workplace's specified tasks. Show me the cleaning record and areas you want inspected.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 記録はこちらです。机と床は作業を終えました。鏡の下の角は、拭き残しがあるか自分では見分けにくいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 作業記録と終えた箇所と判断しにくい鏡の角を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Here's the record. I've finished the desk and floor. I find it hard to tell whether I've missed a spot at the mirror's lower corner.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Show the work record, finished areas and the mirror corner you can't judge. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: そこを一緒に確かめます。気になる箇所は香りでごまかさず、確認を依頼してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: We'll check it together. Don't cover up concerns with scent; request a check.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: お願いします。芳香スプレーは使わず、鏡の角を見ていただきます。やり直しが必要なら、指定の道具で対応します。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 私物を使わず点検を頼み必要なら指定道具でやり直すと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Please do. I won't use fragrance spray; I'll have you check the mirror corner. If redoing is needed, I'll use the specified tools.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Don't use personal products; request inspection and redo with specified tools if needed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 確認したところ、その角に拭き残しがあります。こちらの指定の道具で、仕上げをやり直してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: We've checked, and there's a missed spot at that corner. Redo the finish with these designated tools.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-05-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-05-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 分かりました。角をやり直してから、仕上がりの確認をお願いします。私物を足すことと丁寧に作業することは別ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-05-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 拭き残しを直して再確認を頼み私物追加と丁寧な作業を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-05-001-SHARED-1.translation: Understood. I'll redo the corner and then ask for a final check. Adding personal products and doing careful work are different things.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-05-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Fix the missed spot, request rechecking, and distinguish adding personal supplies from careful work. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-05-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-05-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: はい、やり直した後に確認します。それでは、指定の作業をお願いします。お疲れさまです。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-05-001-SHARED-1.translation: Yes, I'll check after you've redone it. Please carry out the specified work. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 作品の表示について、ご質問はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: Any questions about the artwork labels?

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: この絵には「無題」とあります。名前がまだ決まっていないか、印刷を忘れたのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 無題という表示が未決定や印刷漏れか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: This painting says Untitled. Is its name undecided, or did someone forget to print it?
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask whether Untitled means undecided or omitted printing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: この展示では「無題」が作品の名称として表示されています。印刷漏れではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: In this exhibition, Untitled is displayed as the artwork's name. It isn't a printing omission.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: そうでしたか。私は海の絵に見えたので、「青い港」とメモしました。それが正式な作品名だと友達へ伝えるところでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 自分で付けた青い港を正式名称として伝えそうだったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: I see. It looked like the sea to me, so I wrote Blue Harbor. I nearly told my friend that was the official title.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Explain you almost presented your own Blue Harbor name as the official title. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: ご自身が付けた言葉は、感想として残せます。正式な名称と区別して書いておくとよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: You can keep words you've chosen as your own impressions. It's good to distinguish them from the official title.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 作品名は「無題」と書き、その下に「自分には港のように見えた」と残します。ほかの作品と区別する情報はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 名称と感想を分けて記録し作品識別情報を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'll write Untitled as the title, then underneath it looked like a harbor to me. Is there information to distinguish it from other works?
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Record title separately from impressions and ask about identifying information. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: こちらの表示には作品番号もあります。名称と番号を一緒に控えていただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: The label also has a work number. You can note both name and number.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 番号を控えます。題名がないから何も感じてはいけない、という意味ではありませんよね。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 番号を記録し題名がなくても印象を持ってよいか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'll note the number. A lack of title doesn't mean I'm not allowed to feel anything about it, does it?
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Record the number and confirm you may still form impressions despite no title. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい。感じたことはご自身の言葉でどうぞ。作者の意図として断定することとは別です。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: Of course. Express your feelings in your own words. That's separate from declaring the artist's intention.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-06-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-06-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 分かりました。友達には作品名と番号を伝えたうえで、港のように見えたのは私の印象だと話します。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-06-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 友達へ正式表示と自分の印象を区別して伝えると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-06-001-SHARED-1.translation: Understood. I'll tell my friend the official title and number, then explain that seeing a harbor was my own impression.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-06-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Tell your friend the official labeling separately from your impression. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-06-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-06-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: どうぞ、ご自身の見方も大切にしてください。それでは、ごゆっくりご鑑賞ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-06-001-SHARED-1.translation: Please value your own way of seeing it too. Enjoy viewing at your leisure.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: お夜食をお探しですか。どなたがお召し上がりになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: Are you looking for a late-night snack? Who will eat it?

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 同僚の分も買います。あの人の国では辛い料理が多いと思うので、いちばん辛い物を選ぼうとしていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 同僚の夜食を出身国のイメージで辛い品にしようとしたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'm buying for a coworker too. I thought their country has lots of spicy food, so I was about to choose the spiciest item.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say you nearly chose a spicy snack for your coworker based on an image of their home country. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: その方ご自身が、辛い物がお好きだとおっしゃっていましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: Has that person themselves said they like spicy food?

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: いいえ、聞いていません。前に一緒に食べた時は、辛くない物を選んでいました。国のイメージだけで決めようとしていましたね。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 辛さの好みは聞かず本人は辛くない品を選んだと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: No, I haven't asked. When we ate together before, they chose something not spicy. I was deciding just from an image of their country.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Explain you haven't asked their spice preference and they previously chose a non-spicy item. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 普段の好みを参考にされてはいかがでしょうか。味の説明は、商品の表示でご案内できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: Why not use their usual preferences as a guide? I can explain flavors using the product labels.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: お願いします。同僚は休憩で少しだけ食べたいと言っていました。辛さだけでなく、量も見て選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 本人の少量希望を伝え味と量の表示を確認したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: Please do. They said they wanted just a little during their break. I'd like to choose by portion size as well as spice.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: State their request for a small amount and ask to check flavor and quantity labels. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: こちらの品は辛さの説明と内容量が表示されています。二つの品を比べてみますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: This product displays spice information and net quantity. Would you like to compare two items?

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 比べます。こちらの小さい品は、強い辛さを加えていない表示ですね。以前同僚が選んだ物と同じかも確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 小さい品の辛さと以前本人が選んだ商品かを確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: Yes. This smaller one says it has no strong added heat. I'll also check whether it's the same one my coworker chose before.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Check the small item's spice description and whether it's the product your coworker chose before. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 商品名と包装はこちらです。覚えている品と違う場合は、その方へ確認してから決められます。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: Here's the product name and packaging. If it differs from what you remember, you can ask them before choosing.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-07-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-07-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 前に食べていた品でした。これを一つ買います。渡す時に、次はどんな味が好きか本人に聞いてみます。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-07-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 以前の品を一つ買い今後は本人へ好みを聞くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-07-001-SHARED-1.translation: It's what they ate before. I'll buy one. When I give it to them, I'll ask what flavors they like for next time.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-07-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Buy one of the previous item and say you'll ask their own preferences in future. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-07-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-07-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: お決まりですね。お選びの品のお会計をご案内します。それでは、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-07-001-SHARED-1.translation: You've decided, then. I'll show you to checkout for that item. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 絵はがきをお選びでしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 雪の絵が気に入りました。遠くの友人に「そちらも寒いですね」と書こうと思いますが、変でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 雪の絵はがきで友人も寒いと書くのが適切か相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: I like the snow illustration. Would it be odd to write to my faraway friend that it must be cold there too?
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask whether writing that your friend is cold too suits a snowy postcard. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: お友達のお住まいの季節や天気は、お聞きになっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: Have you asked about the season or weather where your friend lives?

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: そういえば、昨日は暑いと言っていました。こちらで上着を着るようになったので、相手も寒いと思い込んでいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 友人は暑いと言ったのに自分の気候を当てはめたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: Come to think of it, they said it was hot yesterday. I started wearing a jacket here and assumed they were cold too.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Explain you applied your own climate despite your friend saying it was hot. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: こちらの近況として書くなら、雪の絵を選ぶこともできます。挨拶の文章は、ご自身の言葉でどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: You can choose a snow illustration to write about your own situation. Please use your own words for the greeting.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: では、「こちらは寒くなりました。この雪の絵を見て、冬を楽しみにしています」と書きます。相手も同じ季節だとは書きません。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 自分の近況と冬への楽しみを書き相手の季節を決めないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: Then I'll write it's become cold here; seeing this snow illustration makes me look forward to winter. I won't write that they're in the same season.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Write your own news and anticipation of winter without assuming your friend's season. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 絵はがきには、ご自身が今見ている景色や楽しみにしていることを添えられますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: You can add the scenery you're seeing now and what you're looking forward to.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい。ただ、この絵を今日撮った写真とは説明しないようにします。自分が気に入って選んだ絵だと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 絵を今日の実景写真と説明せず気に入って選んだ絵と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: Yes. But I won't describe this illustration as a photograph taken today. I'll say it's an illustration I liked and chose.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Don't describe the illustration as today's real-scene photograph; say you chose it because you liked it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 書き終わりましたら、発送先に合わせた送り方と料金をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: Once you've written it, we'll explain mailing methods and prices for the destination.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-08-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-08-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。友人には今そちらで何を楽しんでいるかも聞きます。本文を書いてから、宛先と料金を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-08-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 友人の楽しみも尋ね本文後に宛先と料金を確認すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-08-001-SHARED-1.translation: Thank you. I'll also ask what my friend is enjoying there now. After writing the message, I'll check the address and postage.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-08-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Ask about your friend's enjoyment too, then check address and postage after writing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-08-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-08-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 発送のご準備が整いましたらお声がけください。それでは、失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-KARUIZAWA-08-001-SHARED-1.translation: Let us know when you're ready to mail it. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご案内を聞いて、気になったお話はありましたか。
DLG-SC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-001-SHARED-01.translation: Was there a story in the guide's explanation that caught your interest?

DLG-SC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 先ほどの伝承を学校の発表で紹介したいです。実際に起きたこととして書いてもよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 案内で聞いた伝承を学校で事実として紹介してよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to introduce the legend from earlier in a school presentation. May I write it as something that actually happened?
DLG-SC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether a legend heard from the guide can be presented as fact at school. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 伝承として伝わる話と、資料で確認できる事実は分けて紹介したほうがよいですね。
DLG-SC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-001-SHARED-03.translation: It's better to distinguish stories passed down as legends from facts verified in documents.

DLG-SC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そうなんですね。私は「この出来事が城を守った」と書いてしまいました。確かめられていない部分はどこでしょうか。
DLG-SC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 既に書いた断定文を示し未確認部分を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-001-SHARED-04.translation: I see. I already wrote that this event protected the castle. Which part hasn't been verified?
DLG-SC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show your definite statement and ask which part is unverified. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今のお話では、出来事そのものを事実と断定できません。確認に使える資料の案内もお渡しします。
DLG-SC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-001-SHARED-05.translation: In this story, we can't establish the event itself as fact. I'll give you information on sources you can use to check too.

DLG-SC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、まず「このような伝承がある」と書き直します。資料の内容と同じだと確認できるまでは、年代も付けないようにします。
DLG-SC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 伝承であると書き直し未確認の年代を付けないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then first I'll rewrite it as there is a legend like this. I won't add a date until I can verify it matches the sources either.
DLG-SC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Rewrite it as a legend and avoid adding unverified dates. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 資料を読んだ後も、どこまで分かったかを発表で伝えるとよいですね。
DLG-SC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-001-SHARED-07.translation: After reading the sources too, it's useful to explain how much you established in your presentation.

DLG-SC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 伝承を消す必要はないけれど、事実と同じ書き方にはしない、という理解で合っていますか。
DLG-SC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 伝承を残しつつ事実と区別する理解を確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-001-SHARED-08.translation: So I don't need to remove the legend, but shouldn't write it the same way as fact. Is that right?
DLG-SC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm keeping the legend while distinguishing it from fact. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。何を根拠に話しているかが聞き手に伝わる書き方ですね。
DLG-SC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. That lets listeners understand the basis of what you're saying.

DLG-SC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。発表の最後に、案内で聞いた話と資料で確かめたことを分けて説明します。
DLG-SC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 発表で案内の話と資料の確認事項を分けると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. At the end, I'll explain separately what I heard from the guide and what I verified in sources.
DLG-SC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll distinguish the guided story from source-verified points in the presentation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞ、調べた過程も大切にしてください。それでは、見学をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please value the research process too. Enjoy your visit.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 展示の道具について、お尋ねになりたいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Anything you'd like to ask about the displayed tool?

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 祖母の家に似た道具がありました。でも、祖母が呼んでいた名前と、ここに書かれた名前が違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 祖母の道具の呼び名と展示名が違うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: There was a similar tool at my grandmother's house. But her name for it differed from the name written here.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say your grandmother's tool name differs from the exhibit name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 形が似ていても、地域や使い方によって呼び名が違うことがあります。どのように使っていましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Even similar shapes can have different names by region or use. How did she use it?

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 豆を入れて、両手で揺すっていたと思います。ただ、小さい頃の記憶なので、道具を取り違えているかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 豆を揺すった記憶を説明し記憶違いの可能性も述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: I think she put beans in and shook it with both hands. But it's a childhood memory, so I may be confusing it with another tool.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Describe the memory of shaking beans and acknowledge possible mistaken memory. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 記憶だけで同じ道具と決めず、展示の用途説明とも比べてみましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Let's compare with the exhibit's usage explanation rather than decide they're identical from memory alone.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 説明には穀物を選り分けるとありますね。祖母には、何を入れていたのかと、どんな字で名前を書くのかを聞いてみます。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 展示用途を読み祖母へ用途と表記を聞くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: It says sorting grain. I'll ask my grandmother what she put in it and how its name is written.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Read the exhibit's use and say you'll ask your grandmother about use and spelling. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 名前の漢字が分からない場合は、言葉の音を記録しておく方法もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: If she doesn't know the characters, you can record the sound of the word instead.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: それなら、聞いた音を先にメモします。こちらの展示名へ勝手に直してしまわないほうがよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 家族の呼び名を展示名へ置き換えず音を記録すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Then I'll first note the sound I hear. I shouldn't replace it with this exhibit name on my own.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Record the family term's sound without replacing it with the exhibit name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい。ご家族の言葉と展示の名称を、それぞれ残して比べられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Correct. You can preserve both your family's words and the exhibit's name and compare them.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-02-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-02-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 家で聞いてから、似ている点と違う点を整理します。昔の呼び名が間違いだったとは言わずに話してみます。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-02-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 家族の言葉を否定せず共通点と相違点を整理すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-02-001-SHARED-1.translation: After asking at home, I'll organize similarities and differences. I'll talk without saying the old name was wrong.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-02-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Say you'll organize similarities and differences without rejecting the family's terminology. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-02-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-02-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: ご家族のお話を聞くよい機会ですね。それでは、ごゆっくりご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-02-001-SHARED-1.translation: It's a good opportunity to hear your family's stories. Please take your time viewing.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 先ほど「もういいです」とおっしゃいましたが、ご注文を取り消すということでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: You said that's enough earlier. Do you mean you'd like to cancel the order?

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: すみません、そういう意味ではありません。待ち時間の説明は分かった、と言いたかったんです。そばは食べたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: もういいですは取消しではなく説明を理解した意味と訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Sorry, I didn't mean that. I meant I understood the explanation about the wait. I still want the soba.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Clarify that that's enough meant understanding the explanation, not cancellation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: ご注文はそのままでよろしいですね。お急ぎのご予定はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Keep your order as it is, then? Do you have an urgent plan?

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 友達との待合せが近いので、時計ばかり見ていました。料理は、もう作り始めていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 時間を気にした理由を話し調理開始の有無を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'm meeting a friend soon, so I kept looking at the clock. Have you started cooking it already?
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Explain why you're watching the time and ask if cooking has started. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい、調理に入っています。出来上がりの見込みは厨房で確認してお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Yes, cooking has begun. I'll check with the kitchen and tell you the expected completion time.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: お願いします。こちらの都合で急がせたくないので、友達には先に店を見ていてもらうと連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 店を急がせず友達との待合せを調整すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Please do. I don't want to rush you because of my own schedule, so I'll tell my friend to look around the shops first.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Adjust the meeting with your friend without rushing the restaurant. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: お待合せを調整されるのですね。連絡中に料理をお持ちしてもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: You're adjusting the meeting, then. May we bring the food while you're contacting them?

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい。電話は外で長くせず、席で短いメッセージを送ります。食事を終えたら合流すると伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 短いメッセージで食事後の合流を伝えると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Yes. Instead of a long call outside, I'll send a short message from my seat saying I'll join them after eating.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say you'll send a short message about meeting after your meal. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 承知しました。ご注文を続けることも厨房へ伝えておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Certainly. I'll tell the kitchen that the order is continuing too.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-03-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-03-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。次からは「説明は分かりました。注文はそのままでお願いします」と言うようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-03-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 次から注文継続を明確に言うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-03-001-SHARED-1.translation: Thank you. Next time I'll say I understand the explanation; please keep the order as it is.
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-03-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Say you'll make continuation of the order explicit next time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-03-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-03-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: ご注文を続けることを厨房へ伝えました。それでは、出来上がりまで少々お待ちください。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-NGN-MATSUMOTO-03-001-SHARED-1.translation: I've told the kitchen you're keeping the order. Please wait a little until it's ready. Excuse me.
